links.comparator_used: Deployed model without fine-tuning, i.e. the static model's declined performance on inference data
links.outcome: Recovery of classification performance metrics after a detected decline
links.effect: Declines were detected in 8 of 18 models; in cases with declines of up to 40.6% (cardiomegaly dataset, InceptionV3), fine-tuning restored performance metrics to within ±2% of baseline values.
